historical_provenance.context: Recorded during the separate bot-prototype qualification and retained as evidence for the adapter changes. The bot implementation, bot binary and bot-only support files are not included in this adapter-only integration. Importing this receipt does not represent a fresh live test of the main checkout. Original statuses, measurements, binary hashes and limitations are preserved.

scope: Original JK1.00 active roster row used by DSS message32, compared with pinned native OpenJKDF2.

original_receiver_proof.stores: 0x4cad2d stores team byte at player+0x139c; 0x4cad33/0x4cad43/0x4cad51/0x4cad5a store subsequent signed16 values at +0x13a0/+0x13a4/+0x13a8/+0x13ac

conversion.native_to_retail: Copy native team low byte26 to retail20; copy native20..25 to retail21..26; copy native28..29 to retail27..28. Kills remain full16-bit.
conversion.retail_to_native: Copy retail21..26 to native20..25; zero-extend retail team byte20 into native26..27; copy retail27..28 to native28..29.

live_gui_corroboration.native_human_before_fix: Native GUI score0,kills0,deaths4; original retail GUI score0,kills4,deaths0.
live_gui_corroboration.explanation: Previous converter copied native deaths into retail kills, suicides into deaths and team into suicides, while preserving score.
